item.title: 🔴 Akira hackers disable EDR with Safe Mode, steal data but fail to encrypt
item.description:
Why this matters: Elevated ransomware risk — validate backups and endpoint defenses.
An Akira ransomware affiliate disabled the endpoint detection and response (EDR) solution on a compromised system by restarting the machine into Safe Mode with Networking. [...]

Source: BleepingComputer  |  Severity: Critical  |  Age: < 1h ago

item.title: 🟠 Critical VMware vCenter RCE flaw exploited for reverse SSH access
item.description:
Why this matters: RCE vulnerability — patch immediately, check for exposed attack surface.
A recently patched critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-59310) in VMware vCenter Syslog Server is being exploited in an active campaign to deploy a reverse SSH tool for persistence and remote access. [...]
